title: Near-infrared airglow line list: OH Meinel (0.9-2.5 um) and O2 bands (0.74-2.5 um)
medium: All wl_vac_A values are vacuum wavelengths in Angstrom. wl_air_A is source-provided air (Rousselot 2000 Tables 2/3 only). wl_air_A_derived is computed from wl_vac_A with the IAU standard formula of Morton (2000, ApJS 130, 403, eq. 8).
primary_choice: HITRAN2024 (HITRANonline line-by-line, accessed 2026-11-23) is the primary position source for every OH and O2 line that HITRAN contains. For 16OH Meinel bands the HITRAN2020/2024 positions are a PGOPHER fit (Brooke et al. 2016 constants refit with the Noll et al. 2020 UVES airglow lines). They are more accurate than Oliva et al. 2015 (Bernath & Colin 2009 constants), which deviate by up to 0.74 A for high-J v'=5,6 lines, and than Rousselot et al. 2000 (Abrams 1994 levels; Q-branch Lambda splitting wrong). Oliva 2015 and Rousselot 2000 are kept as cross-check columns with differences in mA. PALACE v1.0 (Noll et al. 2025) supplies the line selection and absolute reference intensities; its OH wavelengths equal HITRAN to <1e-11 A, and its O2 a-X(0-0) wavelengths are HITRAN2020 values that differ from HITRAN2024 by up to 2.7 mA.

columns.wl_vac_A: Primary vacuum wavelength [A]. HITRAN rows: derived as 1e8/nu_vac and printed to 4 decimals (nu has 1e-6 cm-1 resolution, about 3e-6 A at 1.6 um). PALACE-only rows: PALACE lam [um] x 1e4.
columns.wl_air_A: Air wavelength [A] given by a source (Rousselot 2000 Table 3 for OH doublet means or resolved components, Allen 1973 formula; Rousselot 2000 Table 2 for O2 a-X(0-0), 2 decimals). Verbatim string.
columns.wl_air_note: What the source air value refers to.
columns.wl_air_A_derived: DERIVED air wavelength [A] = wl_vac_A / n, with n from Morton (2000) eq. 8 (standard dry air, 15 C, 101325 Pa). Differs from Edlen (1966), the formula PALACE uses, by -1.3e-4 to -2.9e-4 A over 1.0-2.2 um.
columns.uncert_A: Upper bound of the HITRAN position-uncertainty code interval converted to A (lambda^2 * dnu_hi / 1e8). Blank where no uncertainty is stated.
columns.uncert_A_lo: Lower bound of the same HITRAN code interval in A.
columns.uncert_basis: HITRAN nu uncertainty code and interval in cm-1 (HITRAN docs; Rothman et al. 2005 Table 5).
columns.hitran_ierr: HITRAN 6-digit uncertainty-code string (nu, S, gamma_air, gamma_self, n_air, delta_air).
columns.intensity_R: PALACE v1.0 reference line intensity [rayleigh]: nocturnal annual mean at Cerro Paranal, solar radio flux 100 sfu, zenith (van Rhijn corrected), without lower-atmosphere absorption or scattering.
columns.palace_trans_zenith: PALACE reference atmospheric transmission at zenith, PWV = 2.5 mm, Cerro Paranal. Multiply intensity_R by this to get the ground-level value.
columns.palace_ID: PALACE 13-character line ID (isotopologue, states, v', v'', branch, substates, upper rotational level, parity or d/q).
columns.palace_src: PALACE 4-digit intensity-source code (X-shooter, UVES Noll+2020, other: Cosby+06/Oliva+15, model).
columns.intensity_oliva2015_rel: Oliva 2015 observed relative photon flux of the Lambda doublet (table1, brightest = 10000; the same value is given on both components). O2 rows: table2 relative flux.
columns.intensity_rousselot2000_rel: Rousselot 2000 theoretical relative photon flux (Trot = 190 K, Tvib = 9000 K, Mies 1974 A values), arbitrary scale.
columns.A_einstein_s-1: HITRAN2024 Einstein A coefficient [s-1]. For 16OH these are the Ushakov et al. values adopted in HITRAN2024, so they are not the HITRAN2020 A values that PALACE corrected.
columns.band: OH(v'-v'') for X2Pi-X2Pi Meinel bands; 'O2 a-X(v'-v'')' = a1Delta_g - X3Sigma_g-, 'O2 b-X(v'-v'')' = b1Sigma_g+ - X3Sigma_g-, 'O2 b-a(0-0)' = Noxon band.
columns.branch_label: OH main branches: <dJ><F><parity_upper>(J''), e.g. P1e(3.5), the Oliva 2015 / Rousselot 2000 convention. OH satellites: <dN><dJ><F'><F''><parity_upper>(J''). O2: <dN><dJ>(N''). PALACE-only rows: 'PALACE:' + characters 7-13 of the PALACE ID.
columns.F_upper: OH spin component of the upper level: 1 = X2Pi3/2 (J = N + 1/2), 2 = X2Pi1/2 (J = N - 1/2).
columns.parity_upper: e/f parity of the upper Lambda-doublet level (from HITRAN local quanta; verified against the PALACE ID).
columns.N_upper: Upper-level rotational quantum number N (OH: from J and F; O2: N'' + dN).
columns.J_lower: Lower-level total angular momentum J (the number in the parentheses of the OH label).
columns.transition_type: OH: main or satellite (F' != F''). O2: magnetic dipole or electric quadrupole (HITRAN flag).
columns.source_key: Semicolon-separated source keys; the first one is the primary position source.
columns.d_palace2025_mA: (PALACE wavelength - primary) in mA. Non-zero only for O2 a-X(0-0) (HITRAN2020 to HITRAN2024 position update) and 16O17O b-X(0-0).
columns.wl_vac_A_oliva2015: Oliva 2015 vacuum wavelength [A], verbatim (table1 OH: computed, F9.3; table2 O2: measured GIANO, F8.2).
columns.wl_vac_A_rousselot2000: Rousselot 2000 vacuum wavelength [A], verbatim (ESO ISAAC list_v2.0.dat, 3 decimals; O2 rows: paper Table 2, 2 decimals). OH components are assigned by Lambda-doublet matching in wavelength order, because the list has no labels.
columns.d_rousselot2000_mA: (Rousselot 2000 - primary) in mA for the assigned component.
columns.d_rousselot2000_doublet_mean_mA: (Rousselot doublet mean - HITRAN doublet mean) in mA. Use this for Q-branch lines.

caveats: HITRAN states OH Meinel position uncertainty codes 2 (0.01-0.1 cm-1; 9724 rows), 3 (0.001-0.01 cm-1; 1685 rows) and 1 (0.1-1 cm-1; 136 rows). In wavelength this is 2.5-250 mA at 1.58 um. Independent model lists agree much better at low J (Oliva - HITRAN: median +0.8 mA, 68% |d| < 2.5 mA, 95% < 6.1 mA for J'' <= 8.5), but those lists rest on overlapping lab data, so this is a consistency check, not an absolute accuracy.

Oliva 2015 OH wavelengths are computed values (Bernath & Colin 2009 constants). The GIANO measurements themselves were calibrated to about 0.07 A rms. Oliva deviates from HITRAN2020 by up to -0.74 A for high-J lines of v'=5 and 6, the levels that HITRAN2020 corrected with UVES airglow data.

Rousselot 2000 has no machine-readable labels. Labels were assigned by matching Lambda doublets to HITRAN (doublet mean within 0.30 A, mutual nearest). 3182 of 3284 components at >= 8790 A were matched. Rousselot Q-branch Lambda splittings are much smaller than in HITRAN and Oliva (by up to 47 A at J''=15.5 for (8-6) Q1), so Q components should be compared through the doublet mean only.
For the O2 a-X(0-0) band, HITRAN2024 positions differ from the HITRAN2020 values that PALACE used by up to 2.7 mA (high-N lines). The 16O17O b-X(0-0) lines differ by 8-11 mA.

Measured O2 positions (Oliva table2 GIANO; Rousselot Table 2 from Herzberg & Herzberg 1947) carry only 2 decimals and are blend-prone. They are matched to the brightest PALACE line within 0.25 A and serve only as a cross-check.
PALACE-only rows (18OH; O2 b-X hot and sequence bands such as (2-2), (3-4), (0-2)) have no stated position uncertainty. Their wavelengths are Cosby et al. 2006 model positions.

The O2 b-X(0-0) 762 nm and a-X(0-0) 1.27 um airglow bands are strongly self-absorbed by the lower atmosphere (see palace_trans_zenith). The Noxon band b-a(0-0) at 1.91 um is mainly dayglow and lies in a strong H2O absorption region.
HITRAN contains no 18OH lines in 3800-11400 cm-1 (the API returns 404). HITRAN 16O18O/16O17O lines exist only for the a-X(0-0) and b-X(0-0) windows.
The ESO SkyCalc / Noll et al. 2012 line list was not downloaded (431 MB SM-01 tarball). PALACE v1.0 supersedes it.
The VizieR ReadMe files (notes a-l of Oliva table2) could not be read because cdsarc is blocked from this host. The flags are kept verbatim in the raw TSV.
